record.title: Elevated errors with Codex GitHub reviews and pull request merges

updates.body: Some Codex users may not receive automated reviews on GitHub pull requests or may encounter errors when merging pull requests from Codex. We have identified these failures as related to a GitHub service disruption. We will provide further updates as more information becomes available.

GitHub reports that the service disruption affecting pull requests and webhooks has been mitigated. We are monitoring Codex automated pull request reviews and merge operations to confirm recovery and stability.
The GitHub service disruption has been resolved. Codex automated GitHub pull request reviews and merges are operating normally
